1) Clarify your proposed audit log retention window and whether Redwood can provide a contiguous export for the prior 18 months (we're aiming for 12-18 months depending on the final scope).
2) We have a large backlog of transaction-level logs for January-March 2026 that will likely be requested by the auditor; what throughput and SLA can you commit to for an export (size estimate ~1.8TB compressed)?

Can we get a short plan and timing this week? Also attaching our initial questionnaire (BrightLedger_Security_QQ_2026.xlsx).

Thanks,

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear asks and for the questionnaire. Looping in Laura (security lead) and Karthik (sales) to coordinate timeline, capacity, and any contract implications. Quick summary from my side:

- Retention: Redwood can support a contiguous 18-month export for audit purposes. We default to 12 months in our hosted plan; extended retention to 18 months is possible as a term amendment.
- Export SLA: For a one-off bulk export of ~1.8TB compressed, we can run a dedicated S3 export job. Baseline throughput we can commit to is ~250 MB/s sustained on dedicated capacity; with a short-term burst and scheduling window (overnight) we can deliver the export within ~3-4 hours once the job is started.

Outstanding items we need to confirm:
- Whether BrightLedger wants a one-time bulk export or a staged rolling export (preferred for very large sets).
- Whether the extra retention (18m) will be a contract amendment (term/fee) or covered under the renewal upsell.

Laura — can you add the technical runbook and any minimum notice we need for a burst window? Karthik — I pasted the deal id above, likely will drive pricing for the retention uplift.

Connor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: log retention and evidence path for renewal

Hi Maya / team — technical notes and proposal below. Attaching our export runbook PDF for operations: redwood-s3-export-runbook.pdf.

Proposed approach (operational controls + SLA):

- Export method: secure S3 staging using an ephemeral bucket in BrightLedger's AWS account (preferred) or signed transfer if you prefer Redwood-managed staging. Ephemeral buckets reduce transfer time and avoid double-ingestion.
- Throughput: we can schedule a high-priority export window with dedicated GPU/IO resources. Conservative SLA: 200 MB/s sustained; Optimized (with 24-48h notice and short burst capacity add): 400 MB/s sustained. For a 1.8TB compressed set that translates to ~1.2-2.5 hours depending on chosen SLA.
- Integrity & Evidence: each export will include checksums (SHA-256), a manifest with sequence IDs, and a signed attestation PDF for the export job that you can include in auditor evidence.
- Retention amendment: to extend retention from 12 -> 18 months we propose a term addendum (one-time pro-rated seat/GB uplift). Karthik will provide numbers.
- Security controls: exports are logged, keys rotated for the job, and access limited to a short list (we'll need IAM role ARNs).

Please confirm:
- IAM role or Redwood-managed staging?
- Desired SLA (Conservative / Optimized)?
- Target date/time window for the export (we need a 48h lead).

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Security Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-s3-export-runbook.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:07:00 -07:00

Maya — following up on commercials. Two pricing lines to make contracting straightforward:

1) Retention uplift (12 -> 18 months): one-time prorated adjustment + monthly uplift. Example for your current volume: one-time fee $6,000 + $1,200/mo ongoing. Exact numbers will be finalized once legal confirms effective date.
2) Bulk export operational fee (dedicated burst window + attestation & checksums): $2,000 one-time for Optimized SLA (400 MB/s) or $800 for Conservative SLA (200 MB/s).

If both are required before the auditor arrives we can roll them into the renewal amendment. If you'd like, I can send a one-line amendment and a DocuSign envelope to speed approvals.

Connor — happy to discuss discounts tied to a 12-month commitment on the uplift.

-Karthik
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
